Messages.Author: ANVIL
Messages.Body:
Ok, this goes back to Non-Cammies and voting etc.

Let's say I give a non-cammie the 'Writ'
Right?
Then he/she calls a vote making them Prince of Kalamazoo
Now I want another non-cammie to call a praxis seazure
So I transfer the 'writ' (as I can do, it's equipment)
to the new vampo before it calls the vote.

Now the Prince of Kalamazoo is no longer a Cammie... Right?
He/she doesn't have the 'writ'
But she does have the title.
Or does he/she lose the title?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:




He keeps the title. Changing clans (Gangrel->Assamite) and/or sects
(Non-Cam -> Camarilla) doesn't change anything currently affecting
the vampire. He keeps any votes/titles that he had (this includes
remaining the Justicar of a Clan that he no longer belongs to, in the
case of Clan Impersonation), as well as any other permanents effects
(like "Archon" or "Camarilla Exemplary") that he is now prevented from
acquiring.
